items.title: What’s News: Business & Finance
items.summary: WHATS NEWS BUSINESS FINANCE L3Harris Technologies, the contractor that overhauled a Qatari jet for use as Air Force One, replaced Christopher Kubasik as chairman and CEO after an investigation found that he violated the company’s code of conduct.

items.title: Paramount wants a $1.9 billion bond from state AGs fighting the Warner Bros. merger
items.summary: Paramount wants the states that are suing over the Warner Bros. Discovery deal to post a $1.9 billion bond. The states are scoffing at the idea.

items.title: Paramount Wants $1.88 Billion Bond From States, Writers Challenging Warner Deal
items.summary: The company says the litigants who sued to stop the deal should have to cover financial damages if they lose their lawsuit.

items.title: What Does Paramount Skydance (PSKY) Offer Extension Mean For Its Pending Acquisition?
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (NasdaqGS:PSKY) extended the expiration dates of its previously announced exchange and tender offers to align more closely with its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The updated timing is intended to keep the offers synchronized with the broader transaction process for the planned Warner Bros. Discovery deal. The move indicates that Paramount Skydance is continuing to prepare for a significant consolidation step in the media and entertainment industry. This...

items.title: Dan Loeb, David Einhorn and George Soros All Just Bought the Same Stock and It’s One You Probably Don’t Own
items.summary: Dan Loeb just deployed over half a billion dollars into a battered media stock that activist, value, and macro investors almost never agree on, and he was not alone in the quarter.

items.title: Netflix Stock Has Fallen On Slowing Sales While Margin And Buybacks Compound Earnings
items.summary: Netflix's revenue growth is cooling, and the line that actually compounds for shareholders has been running far ahead of it.

items.title: Billionaires Are Betting on This Overlooked Stock. Should You Buy?
items.summary: Daniel Loeb just made Warner Bros. Discovery his largest new position, exiting Nvidia and Broadcom to fund it. Here is what billionaires see that most analysts are still missing.

items.title: A Warner Bros. Discovery Director Sells Nearly 70% of Their Direct Stake Worth $2 Million as the Company's Paramount Skydance Merger Runs into Challenges
items.summary: The insider dumped a substantial portion of their direct holdings after the stock surged 130% over the past year.
